scope: Bibliographic and claim-level audit of substantive sources cited in authored documentation, provenance and literature synthesis. Frozen search records retain their historical screening evidence; excluded search hits are not implied to support project claims.
limits: Source access is recorded per entry; abstract or metadata access is not full-text appraisal.
No new formal systematic review, duplicate screening, comprehensive supplement appraisal or independent biological validation was performed.
Existing data, metrics, licenses and frozen search logs were preserved.

references.title: Morphology and gene expression profiling provide complementary information for mapping cell state
supported_claims: Source study’s Cell Painting/gene-expression comparison, 48-hour A549 context, usual micromolar doses, imperfect mechanism annotations and well-position effects.
limitations: Complete main text was retrieved in two chunks; sections bearing on claims were inspected. Supplementary material was not comprehensively reviewed.
The repository does not reproduce its full assay comparison or full feature analysis.
corrections: Completed and standardized the bibliography, including verified journal coordinates and PMID; earlier narrative-only citations now have full entries where needed.
